thread:
maria: FYI seeing SSO failures for a subset of AAD customers after the IdP cert rotate. ACS rejects the SAML response with 'Invalid NameID: invalid character'. Looks correlated with users that have accented chars in their emails (e.g. josé@contoso.com). Anyone seen NameID charset handling problems before?
aj: Can you paste the ACS error + a redacted raw SAML snippet?
maria: log: `ACS: saml:processing error: invalid NameID characters in assertion (NameID=\'josé@contoso.com\')`
raw (redacted base64): `PHNhbWxwOlJlc3BvbnNlIE...`
xml snippet:
```
<NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress\">josé@contoso.com</NameID>
```
devon: That XML contains UTF-8 characters. Our SP lib version matters here — older saml libs did some ascii-only normalisation. Which sp-lib version is in prod?
maria: prod is on sp-lib v2.3.1. We pushed v2.4.0 to staging last week but didn't promote. @samir can you check if v2.4 had encoding fixes?
samir: v2.4.0 explicitly switched XML parsing to use unicode-aware normalisation and fixed a bug where NameID bytes were coerced incorrectly. Also, unrelated but suspicious: we rolled out a proxy cookie sanitizer last month to enforce __Secure/__Host prefixes, the sanitizer uses a regex that isn't utf8-safe and can drop bytes if cookie names/values contain non-ascii. If that happens while parsing a multipart POST the body boundaries can be shifted and the XML parser sees truncated/invalid sequences -> invalid char errors.
aj: Wait, cookie sanitizer corrupts POST bodies? Where in the stack is that running?
samir: front-end proxy (edge-proxy) — it inspects Cookie headers and rewrites them. The quick regex replace we used wasn't careful about multibyte sequences. Repro is straightforward:
```
curl -v -X POST https://acs.redwood.ai/sso/saml/acs \ 
  -F 'SAMLResponse=<base64-assertion-containing-accented-nameid>' \ 
  -H 'Cookie: session=abcd; locale=es-ES; user=josé'
```
maria: That matches the customer repro. OK, proposed plan: (1) roll back the cookie sanitizer to the utf8-safe implementation, (2) promote sp-lib v2.4.0 to prod (smoke in canary), (3) notify affected customers with workaround (map NameID to ascii-safe attribute on IdP while we fix).
aj: I'll own 1 and 2. Will create a PR for the sanitizer rollback and a release for the sp-lib bump. samir, can you open a postmortem if we need a rollback escalation? Also double-check KMS logs in case any assertions were encrypted with an external key and failing decrypts.
samir: assertions are encrypted with our SP private key (not via KMS) so not seeing decrypt errors in KMS, but I'll still scan logs.
idp-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back proxy cookie sanitizer on production at 2024-06-18T15:02Z per rollback request #1234.
maria: Confirmed auths healthy for affected tenants in the last 10m. Closing this thread, will follow up with a short postmortem and PRs for both sanitizer fix and sp-lib bump. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
